coverage.publicationThreshold: 75% minimum CV match; 90%+ is the strong-match view
coverage.sourceCoveragePrinciple: 15 named German portals are mandatory discovery sources, not the complete universe; search continues through public employment, research, university, employer, ATS, MedTech ecosystem, specialist recruiter, aggregator and other reputable job-board sources.
additionalGermanySourceLayers: other reputable job boards and aggregators
coverage.searchMethod: Broad discovery everywhere relevant; 0-years hard gate; genuine CV/technical match; current vacancy verification; explicit language/work-authorization assessment; vacancy-fingerprint deduplication; persistent rediscovery; false-negative hunt; publish only matches at or above 75%.
coverage.acceptanceAssessment: PASS for the expanded-source acceptance refresh with the new 75% minimum publication threshold. 90%+ remains the strong-match view. The search universe was widened without widening publication criteria. Eight previously active sub-75% opportunities are now excluded from the portal display, while their records remain retained for audit/rollback. No generic job-board inventory is published merely because it is discoverable.
limitations: A 75% score is a modelled CV-fit assessment, not a guarantee of hiring success
Search engines and portals expose different subsets and metadata
No single run can honestly claim 100% recall across every European vacancy
Work authorization remains country/role-specific unless explicitly verified
Job-board result counts are inventory indicators, not candidate-fit counts
Several discovered opportunities were deliberately excluded because of experience, language, technical-fit or verification conflicts
